title: Pivot Stator Holder
subtitle: #200-002 · reference mesh and 200-002_PivotStatorHolder.scad renders · feature names for the conversion

labels.text: F1 flange, z 0–2: the Arm Body's outline, R36.5 with four ears to r 41.547
K1 ear slots ×4, 4.0 × 10.0 on r 35.516, through F1
P1 pegs ×4 on Ø43 at 0/90/180/270°, Ø3.5 with Ø2.0 through, z 2–11
H1 screw holes ×2 on Ø43 at −45°/135°, Ø3.0, z 11–16
S1 C-201 seat (revised): 6 × Ø3.4 on Ø44, M3 nut pockets from the back face

notes.heading: Frame
notes.text: The reference's own: the J2 axis on +Z, the recess opening at z 0, its floor at z 11, the back face at z 16. The body slides into the Arm Body's Ø65 bore; the ear slots ride the Stator Balancers' shanks.

notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation, so it should hide the mesh entirely. The revised render replaces the pegs and the two screw holes with the shared C-201 spline seat, closes the bore to Ø36, and draws its fits. The dimensions are in 200-002_PivotStatorHolder.scad's header. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
